steps.name: Acquisition & signal
steps.desc: Run control, raw signal formats, adaptive sampling

steps.name: Basecalling
steps.desc: Signal or image to bases, plus modified bases

steps.name: Demux, adapters & artefacts
steps.desc: Barcodes, adapters, chimeras, duplex pairs — the step most often skipped

steps.name: Read correction
steps.desc: Error correction of reads before assembly

steps.name: Read mapping
steps.desc: Aligning reads to references or assemblies

steps.name: Read-based profiling
steps.desc: Taxonomic classification and abundance from reads

steps.name: Assembly
steps.desc: Metagenome and isolate assembly, plasmids, circularisation

steps.name: Genome taxonomy
steps.desc: Placing genomes and MAGs in a taxonomy

steps.name: Annotation
steps.desc: Genes, function, BGCs, AMR, mobile elements, viruses

tools.name: MinKNOW
tools.desc: ONT instrument control software; writes POD5 and runs live basecalling.
tools.note: Version is set per device; check the Software Release Notes before a big run.

tools.name: pod5
tools.desc: Reference library and CLI for ONT's POD5 raw-signal format.
tools.note: Use for merging/subsetting raw data before re-basecalling.

tools.name: slow5tools
tools.desc: Convert, index and subset raw signal in the open SLOW5/BLOW5 format.
tools.note: Compact archival alternative to POD5.

tools.name: readfish
tools.desc: Adaptive sampling (read-until) with custom targets and logic.
tools.note: For depletion/enrichment beyond the MinKNOW built-in.

tools.name: BCL Convert / DRAGEN
tools.desc: Illumina BCL to FASTQ conversion and demultiplexing.
tools.note: Proprietary; adapter trimming optional in sample sheet.

tools.name: bases2fastq
tools.desc: Element AVITI base-file to FASTQ conversion and demultiplexing.
tools.note: Proprietary.

tools.name: Dorado
tools.desc: ONT's production basecaller: simplex, duplex, modified bases, demux, trim, correct, polish.
tools.note: Model choice (fast/hac/sup, version) changes accuracy and artefacts — record it per dataset.

tools.name: Bonito
tools.desc: ONT research basecaller for training custom models.
tools.note: Use only to train or test models; Dorado for production.

tools.name: Remora
tools.desc: Training framework for modified-base models used by Dorado.
tools.note: Custom mod models, e.g. new bacterial motifs.

tools.name: SMRT Link / on-instrument HiFi
tools.desc: PacBio's on-instrument consensus (HiFi) and kinetics-based base modification calling.
tools.note: Revio/Vega output HiFi BAM with 5mC (and 6mA) tags directly.

tools.name: Guppy
tools.desc: Former ONT basecaller.
tools.note: Superseded by Dorado; R9 data only.

tools.name: Dorado demux / trim
tools.desc: Barcode classification and adapter/primer trimming inside Dorado.
tools.note: Trims read ends only — internal adapters and chimeras survive.

tools.name: Porechop_ABI
tools.desc: Infers adapter sequences from the reads themselves and trims ends and middles.
tools.note: Catches unknown/kit-mismatched adapters and splits reads with middle adapters.

tools.name: Porechop
tools.desc: Original ONT adapter trimmer with known-adapter database.
tools.note: Unmaintained since 2018; use Porechop_ABI.

tools.name: duplex-tools
tools.desc: Finds duplex pairs and splits reads at internal adapters (split_on_adapter).
tools.note: Removes concatenated/chimeric reads that inflate N50 and cause misassemblies.

tools.name: yacrd
tools.desc: Detects and removes chimeric and low-coverage regions via all-vs-all overlaps.
tools.note: Chimera screen before assembly.

tools.name: Pychopper
tools.desc: Identifies, orients and trims full-length cDNA reads.
tools.note: Transcriptomics only.

tools.name: Barbell
tools.desc: Fast, pattern-aware nanopore demultiplexer that classifies barcode/adapter layouts per read.
tools.note: Flags concatenated and mis-ligated barcode reads that standard demux keeps; compare against Dorado demux.

tools.name: lima
tools.desc: PacBio barcode demultiplexing and primer removal.
tools.note: Standard HiFi demultiplexer.

tools.name: skera
tools.desc: Splits Kinnex/MAS-Seq concatenated arrays into segmented reads.
tools.note: Required for Kinnex 16S and RNA.

tools.name: HiFiAdapterFilt
tools.desc: Removes HiFi reads containing residual adapter sequence.
tools.note: Residual adapters still occur in HiFi and break assemblies.

tools.name: cutadapt
tools.desc: General adapter/primer trimming and demultiplexing.
tools.note: Amplicon primer removal on any platform.

tools.name: fastp
tools.desc: All-in-one short-read trimming, filtering and QC report.
tools.note: Default first step for Illumina/Element/MGI reads.

tools.name: BBDuk (BBTools)
tools.desc: k-mer based adapter, contaminant and phiX removal.
tools.note: Fast decontamination of short reads.

tools.name: NanoPlot
tools.desc: Length/quality plots and stats for long reads.
tools.note: Quick per-run summary.

tools.name: NanoComp
tools.desc: Compare several long-read datasets side by side.

tools.name: cramino
tools.desc: Very fast summary stats from BAM/CRAM.
tools.note: Stats straight from unaligned Dorado BAMs.

tools.name: chopper
tools.desc: Rust filter/trimmer for long reads by quality, length and contaminants.
tools.note: Replaces NanoFilt.

tools.name: deacon
tools.desc: Fast alignment-free minimizer filter for host/contaminant depletion of reads.
tools.note: Index choice decides what is removed; keep the depleted fraction for audit.

tools.name: Filtlong
tools.desc: Keeps the best reads by length and quality, optionally guided by short reads.
tools.note: Subset for isolate assembly.

tools.name: fastplong
tools.desc: fastp for long reads: adapter trimming, filtering, report.

tools.name: SeqKit
tools.desc: Swiss-army knife for FASTA/Q manipulation and stats.

tools.name: Rasusa
tools.desc: Random subsampling to a target depth or base count.
tools.note: Fair comparisons across datasets.

tools.name: FastQC
tools.desc: Classic short-read QC report.

tools.name: MultiQC
tools.desc: Aggregates QC outputs from many tools into one report.

tools.name: Dorado correct (HERRO)
tools.desc: Haplotype-aware read correction of ONT reads (HERRO model).
tools.note: Built for single genomes; check strain collapse in metagenomes.

tools.name: HERRO
tools.desc: Deep-learning haplotype-aware read correction (standalone).

tools.name: Canu (correction)
tools.desc: Overlap-based correction and trimming, also a full assembler.
tools.note: Slow; mostly superseded by HERRO for ONT.

tools.name: minimap2
tools.desc: De facto long-read aligner; also spliced and assembly alignment.
tools.note: Pick the preset matching chemistry (lr:hq for R10 SUP).

tools.name: pbmm2
tools.desc: minimap2 wrapper for PacBio BAMs keeping kinetics/tags.

tools.name: Winnowmap2
tools.desc: minimap2 variant robust in repeats.

tools.name: BWA-MEM2
tools.desc: Fast BWA-MEM reimplementation for short reads.

tools.name: Bowtie 2
tools.desc: Short-read aligner, common in binning coverage steps.

tools.name: strobealign
tools.desc: Very fast short-read aligner; has an abundance mode for binning.
tools.note: --aemb gives coverage for binning without BAMs.

tools.name: samtools / HTSlib
tools.desc: SAM/BAM/CRAM manipulation.

tools.name: Kraken 2
tools.desc: k-mer read classifier.
tools.note: Database choice dominates results; false positives at low abundance.

tools.name: Bracken
tools.desc: Re-estimates abundances from Kraken output.

tools.name: Centrifuger
tools.desc: Memory-efficient read classifier (compressed index).

tools.name: sylph
tools.desc: Fast ANI-based species profiling against GTDB and others.
tools.note: Strong default for profiling against GTDB.

tools.name: Metabuli
tools.desc: Classification using DNA and amino-acid k-mers jointly.

tools.name: Emu
tools.desc: Full-length 16S abundance estimation by EM.
tools.note: For long-read 16S amplicons.

tools.name: MetaPhlAn 4
tools.desc: Marker-gene profiler.
tools.note: Short-read oriented; human-gut biased database.

tools.name: mOTUs
tools.desc: Marker-gene profiler including unknown species.

tools.name: Melon
tools.desc: Long-read marker-gene profiling with genome-copy estimates.

tools.name: ganon
tools.desc: Classification and profiling with easy custom/NCBI databases.

tools.name: metaFlye (Flye)
tools.desc: Repeat-graph assembler with metagenome mode.
tools.note: Long-time long-read metagenome default.

tools.name: myloasm
tools.desc: Strain-resolving metagenome assembler for R10 and HiFi.
tools.note: New; worth benchmarking against metaFlye.

tools.name: metaMDBG
tools.desc: Minimizer de Bruijn graph metagenome assembler.
tools.note: Fast, low memory; ONT support since v1.

tools.name: hifiasm
tools.desc: Haplotype-resolved assembler; ONT simplex (--ont) supported.
tools.note: Isolates and eukaryotes.

tools.name: hifiasm-meta
tools.desc: Metagenome mode of hifiasm for HiFi.

tools.name: Autocycler
tools.desc: Automated consensus of multiple long-read isolate assemblies.
tools.note: Successor to Trycycler.

tools.name: Canu
tools.desc: Overlap-layout-consensus assembler.

tools.name: Raven
tools.desc: Fast OLC assembler.

tools.name: MEGAHIT
tools.desc: Memory-efficient short-read metagenome assembler.

tools.name: SPAdes / metaSPAdes
tools.desc: de Bruijn assembler with metagenome and hybrid modes.

tools.name: Unicycler
tools.desc: Hybrid isolate assembler.
tools.note: Long-read-first approaches now usually better.

tools.name: hybracter
tools.desc: Automated long-read-first isolate assembly with plasmid recovery.

tools.name: plassembler
tools.desc: Plasmid recovery from isolate data.

tools.name: dnaapler
tools.desc: Reorients circular chromosomes/plasmids to start genes.

tools.name: medaka
tools.desc: ONT consensus polishing with basecaller-matched models.
tools.note: Model must match basecaller version; can hurt metagenomes with strain mixtures.

tools.name: Dorado polish
tools.desc: Medaka-style polishing inside Dorado (GPU).

tools.name: Racon
tools.desc: Generic consensus polisher.

tools.name: Polypolish
tools.desc: Short-read polishing using all alignments (repeat-aware).

tools.name: pypolca
tools.desc: Python POLCA short-read polisher.
tools.note: Pair with Polypolish.

tools.name: SemiBin2
tools.desc: Self-supervised binning with long-read mode.

tools.name: MetaCAT
tools.desc: Metagenome binning by coverage and composition clustering.
tools.note: Default binner in aviary 0.14.

tools.name: COMEBin
tools.desc: Contrastive-learning binner.

tools.name: VAMB / TaxVAMB
tools.desc: Variational-autoencoder binner, optional taxonomy guidance.

tools.name: MetaBAT 2
tools.desc: Classic composition+coverage binner.

tools.name: GraphMB
tools.desc: Uses the assembly graph to bin long-read assemblies.

tools.name: Binette
tools.desc: Bin refinement across binners (DAS Tool successor approach).

tools.name: DAS Tool
tools.desc: Consensus bin selection.

tools.name: CheckM2
tools.desc: ML completeness/contamination for MAGs.

tools.name: CheckM
tools.desc: Marker-gene completeness/contamination.
tools.note: Superseded by CheckM2 for most uses.

tools.name: GUNC
tools.desc: Detects chimeric genomes.
tools.note: Catches chimerism CheckM misses.

tools.name: dRep
tools.desc: Genome dereplication by ANI.

tools.name: galah
tools.desc: Fast dereplication with skani/FastANI.

tools.name: QUAST / metaQUAST
tools.desc: Assembly evaluation, with references if available.

tools.name: BUSCO
tools.desc: Single-copy ortholog completeness.
tools.note: Eukaryotic bins.

tools.name: CheckV
tools.desc: Viral genome completeness and contamination.

tools.name: GTDB-Tk
tools.desc: GTDB classification of bacterial/archaeal genomes.
tools.note: Version must match the GTDB release.

tools.name: CAT / BAT
tools.desc: Contig and bin taxonomy from protein hits.
tools.note: Includes eukaryotes.

tools.name: Bakta
tools.desc: Standardised bacterial genome annotation.
tools.note: Successor to Prokka.

tools.name: Prokka
tools.desc: Rapid prokaryotic annotation.
tools.note: Little development; prefer Bakta.

tools.name: Pyrodigal
tools.desc: Fast Prodigal gene calling in Python.

tools.name: eggNOG-mapper
tools.desc: Orthology-based functional annotation.

tools.name: DRAM
tools.desc: Metabolic annotation and summaries for MAGs.

tools.name: antiSMASH
tools.desc: Biosynthetic gene cluster detection.
tools.note: Long-read MAGs give far more complete BGCs.

tools.name: AMRFinderPlus
tools.desc: NCBI AMR and virulence gene detection.

tools.name: geNomad
tools.desc: Virus and plasmid identification.

tools.name: DIAMOND
tools.desc: Fast protein alignment.

tools.name: MMseqs2
tools.desc: Sensitive fast search and clustering.

tools.name: KofamScan
tools.desc: KEGG Orthology assignment with HMMs.

tools.name: modkit
tools.desc: Modified-base pileups, motif search and DMR from BAM MM/ML tags.

tools.name: nanomotif
tools.desc: De novo methylation motifs in MAGs, MTase linking, bin decontamination.
tools.note: Methylation-aware bin cleaning and plasmid assignment.

tools.name: MicrobeMod
tools.desc: Bacterial methylation motifs and R-M system annotation.

tools.name: methylartist
tools.desc: Methylation plots from modified-base BAMs.

tools.name: MethBat
tools.desc: PacBio methylation analysis toolkit.
tools.note: Replaces pb-CpG-tools.

tools.name: pb-CpG-tools
tools.desc: CpG pileups from HiFi.
tools.note: Superseded by MethBat.

tools.name: Clair3
tools.desc: Deep-learning small-variant caller.

tools.name: Sniffles2
tools.desc: Structural variant caller.

tools.name: inStrain
tools.desc: Microdiversity and strain comparison in metagenomes.
tools.note: Built around short-read error profiles.

tools.name: Strainy
tools.desc: Strain phasing of long-read metagenome assemblies.

tools.name: Floria
tools.desc: Fast strain haplotype phasing in metagenomes.

tools.name: CoverM
tools.desc: Read coverage per contig/genome.

tools.name: mosdepth
tools.desc: Fast depth calculation.

tools.name: sourmash
tools.desc: FracMinHash sketches, search and gather.

tools.name: skani
tools.desc: Fast accurate ANI, robust to incomplete MAGs.

tools.name: Mash
tools.desc: MinHash distance estimation.

tools.name: nf-core/mag
tools.desc: Assembly, binning and annotation pipeline.
tools.note: Short-read first; long-read support growing.

tools.name: nf-core/taxprofiler
tools.desc: Multi-profiler taxonomic profiling.

tools.name: wf-metagenomics
tools.desc: EPI2ME read classification workflow (also 16S).

tools.name: wf-bacterial-genomes
tools.desc: EPI2ME isolate assembly and annotation.

tools.name: mmlong2
tools.desc: Long-read MAG recovery workflow (Microflora Danica scale).

tools.name: Aviary
tools.desc: Hybrid assembly, binning and annotation pipeline.

tools.name: Snakemake
tools.desc: Python-based workflow engine.

tools.name: Nextflow
tools.desc: Dataflow workflow engine behind nf-core and EPI2ME.

tools.name: BandageNG
tools.desc: Assembly graph visualisation (maintained Bandage fork).

tools.name: IGV
tools.desc: Genome browser incl. methylation colouring.

tools.name: anvi'o
tools.desc: Interactive metagenomics and pangenomics platform.
